ex.ko: 아픈 여행자는 2주 동안 격리되었다.

easy: Staying apart from others so a sickness does not spread.

ex.en: My cousin stayed home in quarantine until he felt well.
ex.ko: 사촌은 나을 때까지 집에서 격리되어 있었다.

easy: To ask a question.

ex.en: She queried the teacher about the homework.
ex.ko: 그녀는 선생님께 숙제에 대해 질문했다.

easy: Something that holds a person back so they cannot move freely.

ex.en: A seat belt is a restraint that keeps you safe in a car.
ex.ko: 안전벨트는 차 안에서 몸을 고정해 안전하게 지켜 주는 장치다.

easy: Control over what you do or say, so you do not go too far.

ex.en: He showed restraint and did not eat all the cookies.
ex.ko: 그는 자제력을 발휘해서 쿠키를 다 먹지 않았다.

easy: Awake or alive and strong again.

ex.en: After a drink of water, the wilted plant looked revived.
ex.ko: 물을 마신 시든 식물은 되살아난 것 같았다.

easy: Feeling full of new energy and hope again.

ex.en: After the nap, the puppy felt revived and ready to play.
ex.ko: 낮잠 후 강아지는 활기를 되찾아 놀 준비가 되었다.

easy: A gap where you can see through the clouds.

ex.en: The sun shone through a rift in the clouds.
ex.ko: 구름 사이의 틈으로 햇빛이 비쳤다.

easy: A thin crack in rock.

ex.en: A small rift in the rock was a home for tiny lizards.
ex.ko: 바위의 갈라진 틈은 작은 도마뱀들의 집이었다.

easy: A man whose job is to sell things.

ex.en: The salesman showed us a new bike.
ex.ko: 판매원이 우리에게 새 자전거를 보여 주었다.

easy: A bright red color with a little bit of orange.

ex.en: The scarlet leaves fell from the maple tree.
ex.ko: 진홍색 단풍잎이 나무에서 떨어졌다.

easy: Knowing about something through your eyes, ears, nose, tongue, or skin.

ex.en: Sensing danger, the deer ran away.
ex.ko: 위험을 감지한 사슴은 도망쳤다.

easy: A big underground pipe that carries dirty water away.

ex.en: Rain flows into the sewer under the street.
ex.ko: 빗물은 도로 밑 하수도로 흘러간다.

easy: Toward the direction between south and west.

ex.en: We camped in the southwestern corner of the field.
ex.ko: 우리는 들판의 남서쪽 구석에서 야영했다.

easy: Having to do with the hot, dry part of the U.S. that includes Arizona and New Mexico.

ex.en: Southwestern food often has spicy peppers.
ex.ko: 미국 남서부 음식에는 매운 고추가 자주 들어간다.

easy: A person who speaks for a group or for another person.

ex.en: The team's spokesperson told reporters about the game.
ex.ko: 팀 대변인이 기자들에게 경기에 대해 말했다.

easy: Made to follow the same rules so they are all alike.

ex.en: Students take a standardized test at the end of the year.
ex.ko: 학생들은 학년 말에 표준화 시험을 본다.

easy: One small loop of thread made by a needle when sewing.

ex.en: Grandma sewed the hole with tiny stitches.
ex.ko: 할머니는 작은 바늘땀으로 구멍을 꿰매셨다.

easy: A sudden sharp pain in your side from running.

ex.en: I got a stitch in my side during the race.
ex.ko: 나는 달리기 중에 옆구리가 결렸다.

easy: A ruler of some countries where most people follow Islam.

ex.en: In the story, the sultan lived in a big palace.
ex.ko: 이야기 속에서 술탄은 큰 궁전에 살았다.
